title: stability index metric and per-prompt flakiness gate
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add a 'stability index' signal and a per-prompt flakiness gating CI hook to improve early detection of nondeterministic regressions. Motivation: existing aggregate pass/fail and cohort-level variance signals miss prompt-level instability that causes ribboning regressions in production; this change computes per-prompt entropy over repeated runs, produces a compact stability index (0-100) and enforces per-prompt max-flakiness thresholds in CI. Changes include: new metric implementation with decoupled scorer, CI hook that runs lightweight repeat-sampling on failing smoke prompts, new CLI flags for evalctl to configure repeats/window/thresholds, and dashboard metrics for prompt stability distribution. Includes rollout plan (opt-in flag initially for flaky-allowed repos, follow-up auto-enforcement after 2 weeks), performance notes (adds ~10-20% eval time for sampled prompts only), and links to design doc: https://linear.app/ENG/board/assess-stability-index. Checklist: [x] design doc linked [x] unit tests for scorer [x] CI hook integration tested in sandbox [x] observability counters added [x] migration plan documented.
